purpose: Mark a location, means, or endpoint in formal language.
keywords: The information session will be held in the second-floor meeting room.
We will notify you of the result by email.
Registration for today is now closed.
restrictions: Often replaces で in locations and means; not every で use transfers naturally.
mistake: Avoid treating it as a universal polite replacement for で.
